references.text: Psalm 41:1-3 speaks of the blessing of caring for the weak, which reflects Jesus' words about serving 'one of these my least brothers'.
Hebrews 13:2 encourages hospitality toward strangers, for by doing so one may have entertained angels without knowing it, echoing Jesus' call to serve others as service to him.
James 1:27 defines true religion as caring for orphans and widows in their distress, which parallels Jesus' call to serve the least as service to him.
Isaiah 58:6-7 calls for sharing bread with the hungry and opening one's home to the homeless, which aligns with Jesus' teaching on serving the least.
